 More than 300,000 Toyota and Lexus vehicles are being recalled due to a potentially life-threatening airbag defect.
 Officials say the Takata front passenger airbag inflators could explode, sending metal pieces flying into the cabin.
 Toyota says the Takata airbag recall is the largest recall in automotive history , with over 19 automakers impacted.
 It affects certain vehicle models from 2002 to 2017, including some of the following:
 Toyota Corolla & Sequoia
 Toyota Tundra & 4-Runner
 Lexus SC, IS & GX
 Toyota and Lexus say owners will be notified starting next month. Both companies are offering free repairs and replacements.
